sourceNotes: Brand blue #0044FF taken verbatim from the project's own locked design decision record (brand/FORMAT1-DIRECTION.md, section 1: 'Marka rengi' -- documents a tested shortlist of 4 candidates plus an earlier #0000FF, decided as a brand call). Black and white are not separately documented as hex values but are evidenced directly by the logo files themselves (dedicated all-black and all-white monochrome treatments exist for every lockup). This is a minimal two-tone identity (blue + black/white), unlike the 4-6 color palettes of the other onboarded channels -- not under-researched, just how this brand is built. accent duplicates primary since no second brand color is documented anywhere in the source project.
